//: The map's geometry, in one place: read by the app (charts/region-map) and by the build scripts (scripts/build-geography.mjs, build-satellite.mjs), so they always agree. core: the story's lands, always fully on screen. area: the core and about a fifth more on every side (a third more east and west, for wide laptop screens up to about 2.4:1), the detailed data's extent and what a full-bleed window shows. wide: the extent of the simpler wide data (from the Atlantic to the Caspian, the North Cape to the Sahara's edge: enough for the European Union of 2007, drawn plain, and every landscape screen) (one shape per country), for moments that zoom out to show their neighbours (a moment's view). wideSatellite: the smaller extent of the wide satellite picture, the Roman world round the Black Sea that the zoomed-out ancient moments show (0° E is the NASA tile's own west edge). projection: Lambert conformal conic. All in [lon, lat] degrees.
